results.content: Journal of Clinical Infectious Diseases Society [3(3):p 119-286, Jul–Sep 2025.](https://journals.lww.com/cids/toc/2025/07000) | DOI: 10.4103/CIDS.CIDS_38_25[](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0). **Aims and Objectives:** This study aimed to evaluate whether a shorter incubation period was sufficient for adequate isolation of organisms in critically ill patients and with sepsis, in the BD BACTEC FX automated blood culture detection system, which was used in our institute. **Sensitivity of Tedizolid and Commonly Used Antibiotics against Gram Positive Bacterial Isolates from India (STAR Study)**. This multicentre, prospective, in-vitro study is evaluating Tedizolid sensitivity against 500 gram-positive isolates from various infection sites in Indian patients. Linezolid-resistant(47%) MRSA isolates(MIC>8µg/mL) remained susceptible to tedizolid, with MIC of 0.125µg/mL. Additionally, 30 macrolide-resistant MRSA isolates were also susceptible to tedizolid with MIC ≤0.19µg/mL. Further research is needed to assess evolving antimicrobial susceptibility pattern of Faropenem across bacterial spectrum (aerobic gram positive, aerobic gram negative and anerobic) in large _In Vitro_ samples covering major tertiary care centers across India. *   ### [The Current State of Adult Immunization in India: Challenges and Opportunities](https://journals.lww.com/cids/fulltext/2023/01040/the_current_state_of_adult_immunization_in_india_.4.aspx).
